findings.issue: לְבֹא is a proper noun, so the lamed belongs to the name Lebo. Unmarked “a” adds a destination the token does not mark.
3cp היה has the definite construct “outgoings of the border” as its subject. “serán salidas” keeps the subject of señalarán and makes salidas the predicate.
Proper noun plus directional suffix: “a” renders the suffix, and Tsedadá also keeps that suffix he on the name.

notes: 2mp señalarán is licensed ustedes address; Lebo and Jamat follow the proper-noun tags.
